title: MessagingRoute
description: A messaging workflow: which events go to which messaging connections, filtered how, rendered with which template, and how often. Every event the organisation's producers emit is matched against its routes; a route that takes it renders its template once per target and records each delivery in the console's delivery log. A route whose event types reach a sensitive type (security.*, vault.*, or a sensitive Pix event) is marked sensitive: it may then send to a signed webhook only with allowSensitiveWebhook, and to a GitHub repository only when the repository is private. Each change is recorded as a messaging.route.changed event, as a console edit is. Deleting it stops its deliveries; the delivery log is kept.

displayName.description: The name the console shows. Defaults to metadata.name.

eventTypes.description: The event types the route takes: a type (scan.completed), a family (pix.*), or * for every event. A type that was renamed is stored as its new name.

minSeverity.description: The quietest event severity the route takes.

filters.description: Narrows the route to one scope, and for scan events to the findings that pass the thresholds. An unset condition lets everything through.

scope.description: Only events about this application, version, upload or repository. Each field that is set must match the event.

findings.description: Thresholds a scan event's findings must pass. The event is sent with the findings that pass, and not at all when none do.

isMalware.description: Only malware (true) or only not malware (false).

isExploitable.description: Only exploitable (true) or only not exploitable (false).

hasExploits.description: Only findings whose exploit maturity is one of these.

isEol.description: Only end-of-life packages (true) or only supported ones (false).

eolDays.description: Only packages that reach end of life within this many days.

isReachable.description: Only reachable (true) or only unreachable (false) code.

newOnly.description: Only findings new in this scan.

actorFilter.description: Narrows the route by who acted.

mode.description: any: everyone. include: only the principals and actor kinds listed. exclude: everyone but them.

kinds.description: Actor kinds, such as principal, service_account, agent or system. At most 10.

mentionPrincipals.description: Members of the organisation, by principal uuid, to @-mention on every target that supports mentions. Each is mentioned by the identity the messaging centre holds for them on that provider. At most 25.

mentionStatic.description: Provider user ids to @-mention that are not members, keyed by provider: a Slack user id (U0123ABCD), a Discord user id, a Google Chat user id, a Teams user id or UPN, a Jira account id, or a GitHub login.

template.description: The metadata.name of a MessagingTemplate to render with. Leave it and systemTemplate out to use the system template for each event type.

templateVersion.description: Pin the template to one of its versions. Left out, the route follows the template's latest version. Only with template.

systemTemplate.description: The key of a system template to render every event with (generic, notice, findings.report and so on), instead of the one each event type has. Not with template.

digest.description: How events are batched. immediate sends each event as it comes; window sends one digest every 15 or 60 minutes; daily sends one digest a day at hour in tz. tiers overrides that per delivery tier.

minutes.description: The window, for mode window, or for an immediate route with a tier set to digest (60 when left out).

hour.description: The hour of a daily digest, 0 to 23.

tz.description: The IANA time zone of a daily digest, such as Australia/Sydney.

tiers.description: Per delivery tier: instant, digest or off. A tier left out follows mode.

maxPerHour.description: At most this many messages an hour per target; the rest are suppressed and logged.

includePII.description: Let personal details (a member's email address) into messages. Off, they are masked.

allowSensitiveWebhook.description: Let a sensitive route send to a signed webhook.

mode.description: live sends. shadow renders and logs every delivery without sending, to try a route out.

targets.description: Where the route sends: one entry per connection, each connection at most once. At most 20.

connection.description: The metadata.name of the MessagingConnection to send to. A GitHub Issues connection, which the GitHub App installation makes, is named as export names it.

options.description: Per provider. slack: channelId overrides the connection's channel. jira: projectKey and issueType override the connection's defaults, labels are added. GitHub Issues: owner and repo (required), labels, assignMentions. Other providers take none.

labels.description: Labels to add to the issue. At most 10.

assignMentions.description: Assign the GitHub issue to the mentioned people.
